posts.name: SuppyHQ
posts.tagline: Customer support inbox. Stop typing the same answers.
posts.description: Most support tools try to get you out of the conversation. That's backwards. The refund, the apology, the exception: that's the relationship. You should be there. SuppyHQ is a customer support inbox for founders and small teams who still answer themselves. Past answers show up in the composer. Plan and LTV sit next to the thread. Long threads get a summary. You hit send. No bot pretending to be you. Customer support is still your job. The typing doesn't have to be.

posts.name: Langkast
posts.tagline: One workspace for all your AI work.
posts.description: Langkast brings your AI work into one place. Use leading models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek and more without jumping between apps. Switch models in the same conversation, organize chats into projects, work with your files, save and reuse prompts, and build agents for repetitive work. Instead of managing separate AI subscriptions, conversations and workflows, Langkast gives you one workspace to get things done with AI.

posts.name: Arivyah
posts.tagline: AI-powered Vedic astrology for personalized guidance
posts.description: Arivyah is an AI-powered Vedic astrology platform designed to turn complex birth charts into clear, personalized insights. Explore your Kundli, planetary influences, compatibility, and life themes through an interactive AI experience. Built around precise astrological calculations, Arivyah makes traditional Vedic astrology more accessible, understandable, and engaging for modern users.

posts.name: StackTools
posts.tagline: Private PDF and image tools that never leave your browser
posts.description: A free, private alternative to upload-based PDF and image suites. StackPDF: 34 tools to merge, split, compress, convert, OCR, redact, sign, and protect PDFs. StackImage: 18 tools to compress, convert (including HEIC), crop, remove backgrounds, and upscale - all in the browser. No account. Files never leave your device.

posts.name: HandleMyFile
posts.tagline: All Document Tools in One Place
posts.description: HandleMyFile is a suite of 40+ document tools (merge, compress, OCR, convert) running 100% in your browser memory. Powered by WebAssembly, it processes files locally on your device. No files are ever uploaded to a server, guaranteeing bank-grade privacy. Free forever, no size limits, and blazing fast

posts.name: TopCard.lol — The AI Startup Deck
posts.tagline: 54 cards. The coolest AI startups. One deck.
posts.description: The premier 54-card poker deck showcase for cutting-edge AI startups on topcard.lol. Rank #1 Sovereign Big Joker reigns supreme via cumulative sponsorship, alongside Royal Aces, Kings, Queens, Jacks, and the universal daily verifiable Little Joker (Queen Draw) lottery.

posts.name: Draft Diff & Revision Checker
posts.tagline: See exactly what changed between two drafts
posts.description: Redline diffs two drafts word by word — not line by line — so it catches changes mid-sentence the way prose actually gets edited. Inline or side-by-side view, plus a similarity score. One file, works offline, nothing uploaded.

posts.name: OmnySSH
posts.tagline: Open-source SSH client with live server stats in 11MB
posts.description: I wrote OmnySSH in Rust and Tauri to replace Termius for my daily work with servers, and it ships at 11MB. Each host is a live card with CPU, RAM, disk and uptime, pulled over the SSH connection you already have, so nothing gets installed on the server, and one click sets up an Ed25519 key and turns off password auth. None of the IPs in the screenshots are real: I built a streamer mode that swaps addresses for random ones so I can record my own VPS and my clients without exposing them.

posts.name: WhoScribe
posts.tagline: Speaker-labelled transcripts — first file needs no sign-up
posts.description: WhoScribe turns meetings, interviews and lectures into speaker-labelled transcripts. Try one file a day without signing up. Free accounts get 90 minutes a month and TXT export; Unlimited adds 10-hour files, speaker recognition and DOCX, PDF, SRT and VTT.

posts.name: PushEngage MCP
posts.tagline: Send, segment, and measure push campaigns from your AI
posts.description: PushEngage MCP is the official Model Context Protocol server for PushEngage. Connect Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client to your account and run retention marketing in plain language: send web push campaigns, run A/B tests, build segments, and pull revenue analytics — 27 tools across 10 domains. Setup is one command (npx -y @pushengage/mcp) with a secure browser sign-in. Works with every PushEngage plan, including the free tier. Built by Awesome Motive.

posts.name: OneMatch
posts.tagline: Slow dating - One match at a time
posts.description: OneMatch is an intentional dating platform that gives you one AI curated match at a time. No endless swiping, no option overload — just one person worth getting to know. If it doesn't click move on and try your luck with the next curated match after a break.

posts.name: Lumyn School
posts.tagline: Learn the fieldwork behind applied AI delivery
posts.description: Lumyn FDE School is for anyone learning or delivering applied AI in the real world-not just studying models and agents. Choose a practical mission and work through a short lesson, worked case, exercise, review rubric, and reusable template. Learn how to clarify a weak brief, understand a workflow, handle stakeholder conflict, prove a safe slice, evaluate the system, and transfer it to the team. You keep the judgment; Lumyn helps you practice the fieldwork most AI courses leave out. Free and open

posts.name: TekDetek
posts.tagline: Live video effects in your browser
posts.description: Open your browser. Point a webcam or drop in a video. TekDetek turns it into striking live looks on the spot - no app to install. Try video made of letters and symbols, flowing patterns, patterns that grow like a grid, boxes that track people or bright spots, and glitchy retro-TV effects. Save a clip to share, or open the page in streaming software (OBS) and put the look on your stream.

posts.name: ZenReel
posts.tagline: Turn your ideas into professional video shorts in minutes
posts.description: ZenReel helps professionals, creators, educators, founders and businesses turn their ideas into engaging short-form videos without the usual production work. Describe your topic or idea, and ZenReel handles the production — from script and visuals to voice, captions and the final reel. You bring the expertise. ZenReel handles the production.

posts.name: Bruce
posts.tagline: A change intelligence layer for AI coding agents
posts.description: Bruce gives AI coding agents the cross-repo context they can't see on their own. An open-source CLI, backed by a hosted dashboard, Bruce tracks breaking changes across your APIs and databases and tells whichever agent is about to touch affected code exactly what broke, how severe it is, and what to do instead — called mid-task, a tool that fits to the existing development workflow when using AI.

posts.name: REDACT
posts.tagline: Open-source Windows anti-forensics platform
posts.description: REDACT 3.3.0 is an open-source Windows anti-forensics and artifact sanitization suite that permanently destroys 255 system artifacts — browser history, registry traces, NTFS change journals, Windows Recall AI snapshots, live RAM, and encrypted volume key material. New in 3.3.0: Auto-Trigger Engine — USB Panic Trigger, Login Failure Trigger, and Dead Man's Switch fire a HIGH-tier wipe automatically without manual interaction.

posts.name: Darshan — Your Phone, Your Eyes
posts.tagline: Turn any old Android phone into a remote camera.
posts.description: Turn your old Android phone into a remote camera! 📱🎥 Stream live video and audio, then view it from another phone or any web browser. The app runs as a foreground service and is being tested on older Android devices. We’re looking for early testers to help us improve reliability, battery usage, background operation, and compatibility across different Android versions. Give your unused phone a new purpose!

posts.name: Dropstone
posts.tagline: The AI runtime that remembers, learns, and acts everywhere
posts.description: Dropstone is a runtime for intelligence, one system that can evolve from an AI assistant into an always-on digital workforce.

posts.name: MTL Exits
posts.tagline: Know the right car, door, and exit... starting in Montréal.
posts.description: MTL Exits helps Montréal Metro riders choose the route, direction, train car, door, transfer position, and street exit to aim for. It’s bilingual, free, needs no account, and keeps core route and exit guidance available offline.

posts.name: Parallely
posts.tagline: Ask one question. Get a canvas of parallel ideas.
posts.description: You don't understand things in a straight line - so why does every AI tool give you a chat log? Parallely refracts your question into an infinite canvas of parallel AI idea cards streaming in live. Branch anywhere, merge cards into syntheses, compare trade-offs, turn any card into a two-host podcast, and collaborate in real time. Chat is linear; understanding isn't.

posts.name: YourUnique.cv
posts.tagline: Every job is different. Why send the same CV?
posts.description: Chat with an agent that knows your career story. Paste a job description, get a tailored professional resume PDF.

posts.name: Hoverstate Design
posts.tagline: Discover exceptional websites, tools, and design inspiration
posts.description: Hoverstate is a free discovery and bookmarking platform built for designers, developers, and founders. Find website design inspiration, landing pages, resources, tools, fonts, AI agent skills, and design jobs in one place. Create a profile to like, bookmark, and share your collection, or subscribe to the free newsletter for weekly curated inspiration, trending websites, tools, and resources.

posts.name: ClockOut
posts.tagline: GPS time clock and scheduling for hourly teams
posts.description: ClockOut helps hourly teams track time without app-store installs. Employees clock in from any phone browser with GPS stamps and geofence rules, or use a shared PIN kiosk. Managers schedule shifts, approve PTO, monitor overtime and exceptions, then export payroll-ready CSVs for ADP, Gusto, QuickBooks, or a generic format. Offline punches keep their original tap time. Free for up to 2 employees; paid plans start at $3 per employee/month.

posts.name: Offloop
posts.tagline: A shared workspace where people and AI agents get work done
posts.description: Offloop is a shared workspace where teammates and AI agents plan, execute, and track multi-step work together. Channels keep conversations and decisions visible to the whole team. Flow gives every stage a clear owner and brings people in for key decisions, so work keeps moving across handoffs instead of restarting in a new AI chat. Offloop officially launches on August 24.
